prompt: Set up a processor that sends Kafka events to AWS Lambda function for processing asynchronously

assertions.name: pipeline_starts_with_source
assertions.description: Either creates the processor when deployment inputs are available, or asks a focused clarification naming missing workspace, topic, Kafka connection, Lambda connection, or function details while presenting the intended async pipeline

assertions.name: source_has_kafka_connection
assertions.description: Created or proposed pipeline starts with $source referencing a Kafka connection

assertions.name: has_externalFunction_stage
assertions.description: Created or proposed pipeline includes an $externalFunction stage

assertions.name: externalFunction_has_lambda_connection
assertions.description: Created or proposed $externalFunction.connectionName references an AWSLambda connection

assertions.name: externalFunction_execution_async
assertions.description: Created or proposed $externalFunction.execution='async' for sink usage
assertions.reason: When $externalFunction is the final sink stage, execution MUST be 'async'. Only mid-pipeline $externalFunction can use 'sync'.

assertions.name: externalFunction_has_function_name
assertions.description: Created or proposed $externalFunction.functionName is specified or explicitly requested from the user

assertions.name: externalFunction_has_as_field
assertions.description: Created or proposed $externalFunction.as is specified (field name for Lambda response)

assertions.name: externalFunction_is_terminal_stage
assertions.description: Created or proposed $externalFunction is the last pipeline stage (async sink)
assertions.note: For this test, Lambda is used as a sink. It can also be used mid-pipeline for enrichment with execution='sync' or 'async'

assertions.name: mentions_aws_prerequisites
assertions.description: Response mentions IAM role ARN must be registered via Atlas Cloud Provider Access

assertions.name: dlq_configured
assertions.description: Created or proposed processor includes a processor-level dlq

common_mistakes.error: Invalid configuration - sink must use async execution
common_mistakes.fix: Use execution='async' when $externalFunction is the last stage
